2000-F00-STS-PP-10001 - Piping Materials and Valves (Appendix B - Valve Datasheets)
Design, manufacture and assembly of control valves including, but not limited to:
·          Valve as specified on the control valve list and valve datasheet
o     Vendor to confirm valve sizing for modulating control valves
·          Pneumatic actuator as specified on control valve list, with 316SS quick connect push-in fittings
·          Positioner as specified on the control valve list, mounted onto valve actuator
·          Valve position feedback via positioner feedback transmitter or position limit switches as specified on control valve list.
·          All valve mounted instruments to be pre-terminated to local junction box mounted on valve body
o     Junction box to be 316SS, Enclosure rating IP65
o     Cable glands shall be IP66/68 nickel plated brass with metric threads to AS/NZS 60079, with PVC shrouds
o     Cables to valve mounted instruments shall be installed within flexible anaconda
·          Valve Control Panels. Panels shall include:
o     Material of Construction to be 316SS with hinged door and mounting brackets. Enclosure rating of IP65
o     Air supply pressure of 400 - 1,000 kPag
o     Labelling of control panel tag number and associated valve tag numbers and solenoid valve tag numbers for easy identification
▪     All external labelling to be 316SS fixed with screws to control panel door
o     Pneumatic filter regulator complete with pressure gauge and normally closed automatic drain
▪     The filter regulator automatic drain shall be piped to outside the enclosure
o     Solenoid valve as per control valve list, with opening adjustment for valve opening and closing speed (for open/closed valves)
o     Isolation valve with bleed and silencers
▪     One for each solenoid mounted in panel, and one for the entire control panel
o     Pneumatic fittings to be 316SS, quick connect push-in tube fittings
o     Tubing penetrations shall be standard bulkhead fittings
o     Vendor to specify required air tubing size and ports, size to be common across a number of valve sizes
▪     Tubing to be DIN73378 PA12 Blue Nylon pneumatic tubing
o     Pneumatic Schematic Drawing installed inside panel
o     Termination strips for valve instrumentation, complete with required fixing hardware such as endplates and end clamps.
o     All vendor wired cables to come equipped with bootlaces and ferrules labelled as per EPC termination diagrams/naming convention
o     All controller and transmitter signals to be 4-20 mA, solenoid and position switch signals to be 24Vdc
·          All ancillary items and special tools normally supplied with, or required to adjust and maintain all components associated with the equipment.
·            All equipment to be supplied in accordance with the above referenced specifications.
·            Any non-conformances with the specifications shall be clarified with the Principal for approval.
·            Vendor data and documentation in accordance with 2000-MEP-PP007-SCH1.
·             Shop assembly and testing to the greatest extent possible with accompanying documentation including but not limited to:
o     Operation of manual, pneumatic or electric actuators
o     Testing of all other auxilliaries to confirm functionality
·            Packaging suitable for transport as per 2000-F00-STS-GE-10001.
·           Delivery as nominated in the commercial documentation.
Excluded from this scope of works shall be the following:
·          Hold-down bolts, nuts, and washers at structural steel.
·          Supply of all power, control, and instrumentation cabling outside battery limits.
·          Lubricants and greases, other than initial fill quantities applied during shop assembly and /or preparation for shipment.
The works covered by this datasheet extend up to, and include the following battery limits:
·          Inlet and outlet connection of valve body
·          Pneuamatic inlet and outlet connection of actuator
·          Control Valve Instrument Junction Box Cable Entry
·          Pneumatic Inlet and outlet connections of Valve Control Panel

·          Equipment will be operating in a harsh, outdoors environment and handling various solutions, thus, materials and surface treatments must be suitably selected to guarantee the longevity of the components for each individual pump.
·          Design and materials for seals/glands to be suitable for the specified water quality.
·          The equipment may be in contact with process water and slurry which contains reagents, components shall not contain any brass, bronze, or aluminium alloys.
·          All guards shall be capable of being removed without disturbing other parts of the equipment.

·          Where guards interfere with access to lubrication points, stainless steel tubing and fixed remote grease nipples shall be provided so that lubrication can be undertaken without removing the guard and while the equipment is operating.
·          Guards shall have sufficient space for drive and component adjustment.
